name: Mark Stone
description: Press a palm of qi into a flat stone until its mark glows and holds a small charge for the maker.

name: Glow Tether
description: Draw a glowing line of qi across the ground with a fingertip that slows any foe who steps over it.

name: Fixed Pin
description: Drive a pin of qi into a mark so a small plate of force stands before the body.

name: Quiet Glyph
description: Etch a glyph that hums faintly when a body or its qi crosses it and tells the maker which way it went.

name: Short Step
description: Step along a drawn line so that the qi in the line carries the body a pace further than a stride.

name: Dull Brand
description: Press a branded palm into the foe so the mark stored in it discharges as one blunt blow.

name: Anchor Charge
description: Press qi into a small stone until it takes the charge and keeps it for a long count.

name: Set Stone
description: Drop a charged stone at the feet and raise a low plate of force that rises from it.

name: Twin Stones
description: Set two charged stones apart and hold a thin cord of qi between them that snares passing legs.

name: Heavy Pebble
description: Throw a charged pebble so that its stored qi bursts on impact with the force of a hard punch.

name: Silent Anchor
description: Sink qi into an anchor stone and feel through it where other qi touches the ground nearby.

name: Heel Tap
description: Tap an anchor with the heel and let the stored qi push the body a pace to either side.

name: Cracked Anchor
description: Hurl an anchor stone at a foe's glowing mark so the stored qi unsettles whatever the foe was holding.

name: Ward Circle
description: Trace a ring of qi around the feet that holds a thin ward against blows from every side.

name: Open Ring
description: Leave a gap in the traced ring so that a blow slides off the curve and past the body.

name: Ink Spark
description: Flick qi ink from the fingertip onto a mark so that it flashes and stings the foe's eyes.

name: Steady Rune
description: Hold a rune in the air before the chest and let it feed the body a steady push of qi.

name: Breaker Mark
description: Draw a crossed mark over a foe's glowing sign so that the sign breaks apart in the air.

name: Cord Throw
description: Throw a cord of qi to loop a limb and pull it short before the foe can strike.

name: Tight Knot
description: Tie a knot in a cord of qi around a wrist and keep it tight as the foe pulls away.

name: Slack Cord
description: Let a loose cord of qi take a blow along its length and bend the force away from the body.

name: Cord Haul
description: Hook a cord of qi to a fixed mark and haul the body forward one pace.

name: Thread Sense
description: Hold a fine thread of qi in the air and feel it tremble when a body comes near.

name: Snap Tie
description: Release a tied cord so that it whips back and cracks across the foe's arm.

name: Lattice Brace
description: Hold a frame of crossed qi lines before the chest to catch a heavy blow.

name: Grid Step
description: Lay a small grid on the ground and step across its nodes without losing balance.

name: Node Spark
description: Strike a node of the lattice so that it releases a bright crack of force at the foe.

name: Open Lattice
description: Spread the lattice wide to meet a thrust and turn it off the line of the body.

name: Fine Mesh
description: Cast a fine mesh of qi over a limb and hold it fast as the foe struggles.

name: Mesh Sense
description: Spread a thin mesh across the ground to read the weight and number of steps upon it.

name: Corner Pin
description: Drive a pin into the corner of a foe's drawn sign so that the whole sign sags and fades.

name: Charge Frame
description: Set a frame of qi behind the shoulders to feed steady force into every blow the maker throws.

name: Small Seal
description: Press a small seal onto a cup or a latch so that it will not open without the maker's qi.

name: Press Stamp
description: Stamp a sealed palm into the chest so that the held qi jolts through the ribs.

name: Stamp Guard
description: Hold a sealed palm out to take a blow and let the seal spread the force across the hand.

name: Wax Mark
description: Leave a mark of waxed qi on a door or a pack that glows when another hand touches it.

name: Sleeve Lock
description: Seal a line of qi across a foe's sleeve so the arm cannot rise past the elbow.

name: Seal Break
description: Break a foe's small seal with a rapid counter stamp so that the held qi leaks away.
